heading: Art. 131f. Noncompliance with procedural rules
lead: Any person subject to this chapter who— shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

tree.text: is responsible for unnecessary delay in the disposition of any case of a person accused of an offense under this chapter; or
knowingly and intentionally fails to enforce or comply with any provision of this chapter regulating the proceedings before, during, or after trial of an accused;
